title: data.pdf — section 65
text:
(6) Notwithstanding anything in [F58Article 19(1) of the Magistrates’ Courts (Northern
Ireland) Order 1981], a magistrates’ court in Northern Ireland may hear and determine
a complaint for an offence under [F59section 17(3) of ] this Act if the complaint was
made at any time within twelve months from the commission of the offence.
